name: Lyle W Williams
old_description: The Lyle W. Williams team specializes in selling and servicing electrical products for distributors, contractors, engineers, and other end users. We’re a collaborative team with experience in the most demanding electrical market segments.
about:
Lyle W. Williams Company operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where it was founded in 1976. The firm began as a manufacturer's representative agency focused on electrical products, building relationships across the Intermountain and Pacific Northwest regions.

The company represents more than 35 electrical manufacturers, providing full-spectrum support that includes strategic sales and territory management, on-site technical training and certification, warehouse and logistics optimization, and specification and project support. A team of outside sales professionals covers eight territories — Alaska, Eastern Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Utah, Washington, and Western Wyoming — while an inside sales group handles day-to-day coordination from the Salt Lake City headquarters.

Lyle W. Williams serves distributors, contractors, engineers, and end users in residential, commercial, industrial, utility, and data-center markets. Its product lines span energy and renewable energy, telecommunications, data communications, and general electrical construction, connecting manufacturers with customers throughout the Mountain West and Northwest.

The firm emphasizes a solution-based sales process, deep product knowledge, and long-term relationships grounded in integrity, respect, and excellence — values it has maintained for over 50 years in the trade.
